description_en: Queries the intrusion prevention configuration of a specified VPC firewall
description_zh: 获取指定VPC边界防火墙的入侵防御配置信息
name: DescribeVpcFirewallDefaultIPSConfig

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

If the VPC firewall protects a network instance in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, set this parameter to the ID of the CEN instance. To query the ID of a CEN instance of Basic Edition, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345777.html operation. To query the ID of a CEN instance of Enterprise Edition, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2384695.html operation.

If the VPC firewall protects traffic between two VPCs connected by an Express Connect circuit, set this parameter to the ID of the VPC firewall instance. To query the ID of the VPC firewall instance, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342932.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
VPC 边界防火墙的实例 ID。取值：

VPC 边界防火墙防护云企业网内的网络实例时，实例 ID 使用云企业网实例 ID。云企业网基础版通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345777.html 接口，查询云企业网的实例 ID。云企业网企业版通过调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2384695.html 接口，查询云企业网的实例 ID。
VPC 边界防火墙防护通过高速通道连接的两个 VPC 之间的流量时，实例 ID 使用 VPC 边界防火墙实例 ID。您可以通过调用  https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/342932.html 接口，查询 VPC 边界防火墙的实例 ID
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid

BasicRules.description_en:
Indicates whether basic policies are enabled. Valid values:

1: On.

0: Off
BasicRules.description_zh:
基础规则开关。取值：

1：开。

0：关

EnableAllPatch.description_en:
Indicates whether virtual patching is enabled. Valid values:

1: On.

0: Off
EnableAllPatch.description_zh:
虚拟补丁开关。取值：

1：开。

0：关

RuleClass.description_en:
The IPS rule group. Valid values:

1: Loose rule group.

2: Medium rule group.

3: Strict rule group
RuleClass.description_zh:
IPS规则组。取值：

1：宽松规则组。

2：中等规则组。

3：严格规则组

RunMode.description_en:
The mode of the intrusion prevention system (IPS). Valid values:

1: Block Mode.

0: Monitor Mode
RunMode.description_zh:
IPS防御模式。取值：

1：拦截模式。

0：观察模式
